content.summary: The return voyage of the four ships, from leaving 蘇州黃泗浦 on 天寶十二載十一月十五日 (753) to 鑒眞 entering 大宰府 on 十二月廿六日. The documented landfalls are separate dated events; this event carries the span and the named places and asserts no continuous route.

geometry.notes: No route geometry is asserted. The documented movements are the dated landfall events and the named places on this record; the outbound voyage of 752 is excluded from the chapter.

content.editorial_notes: The voyage sequence rests on the biography, a single near-contemporary account; the chronicle independently corroborates the ships' returns and divergent landfalls, not the day-by-day sequence. The coverage model excludes the outbound voyage of 752, so no outward leg or interpolated line exists anywhere in the chapter.

claims.statement: The biography records the four ships leaving 蘇州黃泗浦 on 天寶十二載十一月十五日 and 鑒眞 entering 大宰府 on 十二月廿六日.

locator.value: 十五日壬子，四舟同發; 廿六日辛卯，延慶師引和上入［太］宰府
